Solo Service Operations v0.2.0

Four workflows and a read-only helper for invoices, cash tracking and reconciliation.

Record notes

Four workflows and a read-only helper for invoices, cash tracking and reconciliation.

Version 0.2.0 includes 4 complete skill procedures. Complete methods and synthetic fixtures; no client records or account connectors.

Requirements: Python 3.9+ for reconciliation helper; Your own source records.

License scope: Apache-2.0 with retained MIT role-source notices. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add solo-service-operations@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files and includes a per-file hash inventory. Built from 334c118ac087eabf23c52a265632196818ddc5d3. SHA-256: 7ff332a0ca9f97abb75e50ffd2857dd1388e0ae581f046f0f62f1666e93c18fa.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
